description: cyklodetektory is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Statutární město Brno. English description below. The data show the intensity of cyclists and pedestrians on strategically located bike detectors within the city of Brno. Updates take place every hour. Data is always an hourly summary for a given time period. Coverage: Statutární město Brno. The publisher named on the listing is Statutární město Brno. Its keywords include cyklistika, kolo, intenzita, dopravní proudy, cyklistická infrastruktura, bikes. The listing shows 5 download or service links in ZIP, JSON, CSV, GEOJSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/44992785/0d6f1518d017cc26385f1f9c4bc36342/distribuce/adf23f5c1db2a5df4a6b6107d8f537fd/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
